checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around the rope ends; split rope and cable follow the hands.
checks.feet: Stable seated or tall-kneeling support; fixed trunk and pelvis, elbows spread while pulling rope toward the sides of the face.
checks.movement: Upright bench seated position, feet planted and knees 90 degrees. Rope pulled toward sides of face with elbows outward and stable trunk. Cable pulley at head height, equal fixed-length rope branches and lifting weight stack. 3.5 seconds pull, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
